entries.11df9dfba82b053f: A business that provides brand operators with the EC system and logistics infrastructure built for the EC Mall Business, including 'BOEM/ECS', an EC support service for brands' own official online stores; 'e-3PL', comprehensive outsourcing of warehouse logistics operations; 'LOCOCHOC', which ships out-of-stock store items directly from warehouses; and 'LOCOPOS', which manages store sales and inventory integrated with EC. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥4,471 million.
entries.167586245e1d2d16: The company is headquartered in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, and operates in a single segment covering the sale, planning and purchasing of fashion-related products centered on footwear. It has 9 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 equity-method affiliate, and consolidated employees for the fiscal year ended February 2026 numbered 336. The company is listed on the Growth Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

entries.3b6b95846bee4b90: This business sells brands' products through its own malls, namely 'LOCONDO.jp', 'MAGASEEK', 'dfashion', 'FASHIONWALKER', 'SPORTS WEB SHOPPERS', 'waja bazar' and 'Brandeli', and through 'LOCOMALL' on other companies' malls. There are two models: a consignment model, in which brands open shops and bear no inventory risk (revenue is recorded as consignment sales commissions), and a buy-in model, in which the company purchases and sells products itself. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥7,675 million, and the number of brands opening shops was 5,049.

entries.4957fbd2d6055392: Its strength lies in centrally managing the IT and logistics infrastructure behind its seven EC malls, which allows it to operate multiple malls efficiently. In the platform business, it can take on a full range of services in one package, from support for companies' own official EC sites, warehouse commissioning and store POS to out-of-stock follow-up in stores and core systems. Its warehouse commissioning structure also handles shipments to department stores and wholesalers. Another feature is its approach of carrying out integration after M&A promptly, centered on the use of its own platform.
entries.501af607dff2207d: Under the management philosophy 'HAPPY FOR ALL', the company operates an EC mall business, a platform business and a brand business. It states that it aims to raise corporate value by expanding the EC penetration rate of domestic apparel, clothing accessories and similar goods through greater brand awareness, and by actively investing in new and existing businesses through M&A and other means. It states that it places emphasis on merchandise handling volume (after returns) as its target management indicator.

entries.527198aac39ce755: The three businesses have a mutually complementary structure. Improvements to the EC systems and logistics infrastructure made for the EC malls are automatically reflected in each service of the platform business, and sharing inventory on the platform side expands the products that can be sold on the EC malls. By combining multi-mall expansion through M&A with the establishment of ANBUR LEAGUE, an intermediate holding company for brand M&A, the company combines growth through M&A with the use of its existing base.
